head: fyx (known in Arkaḥ, but not in Kfarze)

examples.turoyo: kǝtli kefe bu šuro du bayto kulle fayixi  (раскрошились crumble; p.c. Isḥaq)
examples.translation: All stones which in the wall of the house, were crumbled.
examples.raw: kǝtli kefe bu šuro du bayto kulle fayixi  (раскрошились crumble; p.c. Isḥaq) All stones which in the wall of the house, were crumbled.(Ilyas p.c)

examples.turoyo: azzan lu ḥsoḏo da tlawḥe, ḥǝngi (ġalabe) našifiwa, fayixi kulle b iḏayna (раскрошились crumble; p.c. Isḥaq)
examples.translation: I went to sowing of lentils, they used to dry very much, all of them crumbled in our hand.
examples.raw: azzan lu ḥsoḏo da tlawḥe, ḥǝngi (ġalabe) našifiwa, fayixi kulle b iḏayna (раскрошились crumble; p.c. Isḥaq) I went to sowing of lentils, they used to dry very much, all of them crumbled in our hand.(Ilyas p.c)

examples.turoyo: Maḥtənne, maḥti maye aʕlayye, maḥtənne bayn am maye. Kfayxi, kfǝrdi (2018_07_01_01.2_Arkah_Ishaq_old_houses_ED: 017)
examples.translation: The burnt limestone crumbles in the water
examples.raw: Maḥtənne, maḥti maye aʕlayye, maḥtənne bayn am maye. Kfayxi, kfǝrdi (2018_07_01_01.2_Arkah_Ishaq_old_houses_ED: 017) (The burnt limestone crumbles in the water)

examples.turoyo: gbayziwa maye aʕlayye, g̊fayxiwa, fəšriwa, fayxiwa, kəmmina fəšriwa
examples.translation: they would pour water on them, they would dissolve, they melted; they dissolved, we say they melted
examples.raw: gbayziwa maye aʕlayye, g̊fayxiwa, fəšriwa, fayxiwa, kəmmina fəšriwa ‘they would pour water on them, they would dissolve, they melted; they dissolved, we say they melted’ (MlfI_Houses2/84)

examples.turoyo: Hawxa u=kalšo saymiwayle bu=šəklawo, kŭl=d-əbʕiwa  naqqa gmaydiwanne,  tloṯ,  arbaʕ kefe, ḥamməš kefe m-anək, gbayziwa maye aʕlayye, gmafixiwanne w gxulṭiwa nqurto appe.
examples.translation: Like so, the lime, they made it this way, whenever they needed, immediately (or: “at the moment”) they took it, three-four stones, five stones of the kind, they poured water upon them, they dissolved them and mixed mortar in them (in the stones)2019_13_01_Malfono_Ishaq
